instructions.primary_message: Cut butter into small pieces. Place in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment; set aside to soften.
Place flour, baking powder, and salt in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dry ingredients and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups all-purpose flour
½ tsp baking powder
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Working over a small bowl, separate egg yolk from white, leaving the white in the bowl. Place yolk in another small bowl, along with vanilla and lemon extract. Whisk to combine and set aside. (Reserve egg white for another use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 egg
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 tsp lemon extract

instructions.primary_message: Once the butter has softened, beat on medium-high speed until light and creamy, 2-3 minutes. Stop the mixer and scrape down the sides of the bowl with a silicone spatula.

Wash, dry, and zest lemons into the bowl of the stand mixer, then add both sugars. Continue to mix on medium speed until the butter mixture is light in color and fluffy in texture, 3-5 minutes more. Stop the mixer and scrape down the sides of the bowl. (Reserve lemons for another use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup granulated sugar
2 tbsp powdered sugar

instructions.primary_message: Add egg yolk mixture to the bowl. Mix on medium speed until fully combined, about 2 minutes. Scrape down the sides of the bowl.
Add dry ingredients to the bowl. Mix on low speed until dough is just combined.
Pat dough into a 1-inch thick disk. Wrap disk tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm, about 30 minutes.
Once the dough is firm, remove from the fridge. Preheat oven to 350°F. Line three baking sheet pans with parchment paper. (Bake in batches if necessary.)
Place the dough between two additional sheets of parchment paper. Using a rolling pin, roll the dough out to a 1/4-inch thickness.

Remove top sheet of parchment paper, then, using 1-inch, 2-inch, and 3-inch circle cookie cutters, cut out cookies. Separate by size and arrange between the prepared baking sheets. Take remaining scrap dough, recombine, and roll out again. Continue to cut out cookies until you have 10 cookies of each size. (If the dough becomes too sticky, return to fridge for 10 minutes.)
Place baking sheets in the freezer until cookies are firm, about 10 minutes.

Remove baking sheets from the freezer and place in the oven. Bake, rotating the sheets halfway through, until cookies are golden brown on the edges and firm to the touch, 16-20 minutes. (The smaller size may bake slightly faster than the larger sizes.) Remove from oven and set aside to cool completely, about 30 minutes.
Once the cookies are cool, gently lift from parchment paper. Using a spoon or butter knife, spread a thin layer of frosting over the top of each cookie.
Stack the cookies based on size, large to small, to make a wedding cake shape. Using the white icing, pipe accents around the edge of each cookie.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (37 g) tube white writing icing or gel

instructions.primary_message: Arrange cookies on a serving platter and enjoy!
